sources.entry: SimpleMind - The world leader in cross platform Mind Mapping tools.

summary.name: SimpleMind
summary.one_liner: SimpleMind is a cross-platform mind mapping app for organizing thoughts, brainstorming, and sharing ideas, sold as a one-time purchase per platform.
keywords: notes and links in mind map
use_cases: building maps with images and checkboxes
summary.what_it_does: SimpleMind lets you place topics anywhere in a free-form layout or use several automatic layouts suited to brainstorming. An autofocus feature hides distractions while you work. You can customize topics and lines, and add colors, images, photos, notes, links and checkboxes. All information can be stored in one mind map, and maps can be shared, for example as a PDF. The latest news items mention version 2.10 with custom backgrounds, outline search and improved read-only mode, and a post on data ownership and privacy.
notable: Free-form and automatic layouts for brainstorming
Single purchase per platform, no subscriptions
Custom backgrounds and outline search in version 2.10
caveats: Pro features such as adding color, images and photos are described as part of SimpleMind Pro, so the free version has limits
Each platform requires a separate one-time purchase
